newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH CLOSING DEBT MARKET REPORT.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH CLOSING DEBT MARKET REPORT.

text.p: Dutch bonds ended mostly firmer on Wednesday, though the short end lost a little ground, after shooting higher with other markets in early trade. Fading bunds shaved back the gains into the close, dealers said.

The Finance Ministry closed its new tap issue of 5.75 percent 2007 bonds, saying a total of 7.5 billion guilders had been raised. This falls short of the 10 billion or so required for a liquid new market benchmark, one trader said.
The last day of the tap sparked lively trade at the long end, he added, with demand for the new issue picking up after sluggish retail on Tuesday.
